question: Preserve scoped reading position through task navigation and native collection updates

evidence.conclusion: Distinct anchor, update restoration, animation and edge-request inputs exist.
evidence.limitation: Presence does not prove active Remote values, algorithm or navigation persistence.

evidence.conclusion: Remote wraps its owned native collection through UIViewControllerRepresentable. Top soft edge belongs to that collection.
Before v550 reading/following state was controller-local; navigation recreated the task-keyed controller without a saved anchor.

implementation: Retain stable row identity, visible-top-relative offset, absolute fallback and tail intent above task navigation using the existing host/destination scope within the single offline account.
Capture user scroll and page exit; restore during collection layout and current snapshot completion. Skip active user scroll and stale snapshot completions.
Keep current-page submission as an explicit tail request. Clamp missing-row fallback and reject nonfinite geometry.
attribution: Independent native integration using existing source-bound collection ownership. Official restoration algorithm and activation policy remain unknown.
open: Row-relative points do not preserve exact characters during same-row revision or reflow.
Official restoration predicates, animated updates and scroll-to-edge control remain open.
History expansion and row removal need more runtime vectors.
Android collection and keyboard behavior require independent validation.
